errors.text_span: Beginnend am oberen Rand zeigt das blaue Segment 'Kultur' einen Anteil von 2,4 Prozent (2014) zu 2,2 Prozent (2021).
errors.evidence: The machine description reverses the values for 'Kultur'; the figure shows 2.2% for 2014 and 2.4% for 2021.
The machine description reverses the values for 'Sport/Erholung'; the figure shows 2.4% for 2014 and 3.6% for 2021.
The machine description incorrectly states 8.4% for 2014; the figure shows 4.1% for 2014 and 7.2% for 2021.
The machine description correctly states the values for 'Abwasserentsorgung' but misidentifies the color as 'hellblau'; it is light purple.
The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Abfallwirtschaft' as violet; it is light purple.

errors.text_span: Das leuchtend grüne Segment 'Stromversorgung' weist 4,2 Prozent im inneren und 8,9 Prozent im äußeren Ring auf.
errors.evidence: The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Stromversorgung' as bright green; it is dark green.
The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Wasserversorgung' as medium blue; it is dark blue.
The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Kombinierte Versorgung' as light violet; it is light red.
The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Übrige Versorgung' as dark red; it is dark purple.
The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Verkehr' as gray; it is light gray.

errors.text_span: 'Wirtschaftsförderung' in einem zweiten Hellgrünton zeigt 6,2 Prozent für 2014 und 4,7 Prozent für 2021.
errors.evidence: The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Wirtschaftsförderung' as a second light green tone; it is light green.
The machine description misidentifies the color of 'Kliniken' as cornflower blue; it is light blue.
